name: ai-toolkit
description: AI Toolkit: spec-driven SDLC, a protected private knowledge base, and coding principles

plugins.name: ai-toolkit
plugins.description: Spec-driven SDLC (at-sdlc) routed across skill libraries, a private knowledge base kept protected and indexed (at-search, at-sleep), a feel loop for games, a real-world (non-coding) execution method for deadline-bound tasks, a Suno workflow for re-lyricing a reference song, independent-judgment and evidence-over-continuity stances for any conversation, a philosophical-thought method that takes any subject past its surface, a prioritization method that prioritizes the most valuable space and makes sure the next step gets done, context budgeting and safe unattended runs for agent sessions, and universal coding principles.
